title: I built a startup simulator with Claude Code. Now I'm thinking about taking it from 2D to 3D.
author: Sad-Loss7089
selftext:
I fully vibe-coded failUnicorn using Claude Code. It's a free browser startup simulator: pitch an idea, get it scored by an AI, then hire people, ship features, run campaigns and manage cash, burn, runway and churn.

I've been thinking about upgrading the 2D design to 3D. For others building games with AI, how do you decide whether a visual upgrade is worth it, or whether to focus on improving the existing game?

Player feedback has given me plenty to work on. Across 216 feedback responses, churn, hiring and getting users are the most common challenge tags. Understanding the game comes up too. These are things players found challenging, not necessarily bugs.

After each finished run, the Stories tab gives you a post-mortem of your decisions and mistakes, plus a shareable result card. There are daily challenges and a leaderboard too.

https://failunicorn.vercel.app
Free in your browser, no signup needed.

If you try it, I'd love to hear whether the first 10 days are clear, and whether 3D would add anything to a game like this.
